project_type: Full-stack web app: Python FastAPI backend + React 19 TypeScript frontend
build_system: Docker multi-stage builds, pip for Python deps, npm for Node deps
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (backend), no test runner configured for frontend
build_command: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt (backend); cd frontend && npm install && npm run build (frontend)
verification_instructions: 1. Backend: pip install deps, run pytest. 2. Frontend: npm install, npm run build (tsc + vite). 3. Docker: docker build for both services.
setup_instructions: Backend: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt. Frontend: cd frontend && npm install.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.11 and Node 22 available.
key_patterns: Backend uses pydantic-settings for config (env vars), SQLAlchemy async with asyncpg for PostgreSQL, Alembic for migrations. init_db() creates tables and seeds roles/admin on startup. All API routes prefixed with /api. Frontend uses Vite with proxy to localhost:8000 for /api in dev mode. Production frontend uses nginx with proxy_pass to docker backend service.
directory_structure: Root: docker-compose.yml, README.md. backend/: FastAPI app in app/, alembic/ for migrations, tests/, Dockerfile. frontend/: React+Vite app in src/, Dockerfile, nginx.conf, vite.config.ts.
